prompt: Gray counts stars from the rooftop
title: Bright Stars
irony: Gray plans to count every star exactly, but the sky keeps adding more, so sharing the count together matters more than finishing the number.
facts: About 2,500 stars show at once on a clear dark night (interestingengineering.com).
About 6,000 stars show across the whole sky to bare eyes (interestingengineering.com).
Stars are far balls of burning gas that look like small dots (0685.com).
Starlight looks twinkly because moving air bends it on the way down (spacenews247.com).
Stars near the edge of the sky twinkle more than stars straight up (startwithabook.org).
City lamps hide faint stars so dark roofs show more (brainly.com).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blankets and pillows cover the big-house rooftop while gray night fills with bright stars above.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green brings star charts while Gray checks lists and Navy spreads blankets beside Blue.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares they cannot count them all as twinkling stars blur and the count slips away.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends chant together on the rooftop while the sparkling sky keeps growing wider.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The crew carries blankets to the street corner but the bright lamp hides the faint stars.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Back on the rooftop steps everyone shouts different numbers and mixes twinkles with new stars.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends chant together again under the wide sky as the night glows around them.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray holds her unfinished list and sings softly for all of them about loving the wide night.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray puts the pencil down and chooses slow counting together while Green nods beside her.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The friends sing the count again while Gray turns the last line toward sharing the sky.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Sleepy friends hum under blankets on the rooftop while Gray keeps the sky, not the number.
